newsitem.title: POLAND: Agros unlikely to pay 1996 dividend - CEO.
newsitem.headline: Agros unlikely to pay 1996 dividend - CEO.

text.p: Polish food producer and trader Agros Holding SA is unlikely to pay a 1996 dividend, the company's chief executive said on Friday.
"A payout is not likely ... in fact it would be a contradiction if we wanted to pay a dividend at a time when we plan a new issue for investment programme," Zofia Gaber told Reuters.

Gaber was speaking after an extraordinary general meeting which approved an issue of 2,425,000 shares to finance its investment programme. The company did not pay a dividend for 1995. -- Malgorzata Rzepka +48 22 653 9700
